sentences.en: But actually, the bottom line is they want to make money and their business of making money is by educating people.

sentences.zh: 所以埃克塞特大学、利兹大学，它们不在迪拜、沙特阿拉伯、科威特、卡塔尔或中东的其他任何地方。

sentences.en: So Exeter, Leeds, those aren't in Dubai or Saudi Arabia or Kuwait or Qatar or anywhere else in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 但伯明翰就像是，好的，我们将把迪拜伯明翰大学建在迪拜，这里字面意义上是旅游业等最受欢迎的地方之一。

sentences.en: But Birmingham is like, OK, we'll put Birmingham Dubai in Dubai, where it's literally one of the most popular places for tourism and so on.
sentences.zh: 并且我们将吸引许多阿拉伯人加入我们的大学。

sentences.en: And we're going to have lots of Arabs to join our university.
sentences.zh: 我们将会让许多阿拉伯人加入我们的大学。

sentences.en: So it was honestly a smart financial move.
sentences.zh: 所以这老实说是个很明智的财务决定。

sentences.en: Like, I've got to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 就，我得老实说。

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我觉得也是。

sentences.en: Might set up an aspiring psychologist Dubai program.

sentences.en: Yeah, very smart, very savvy.
sentences.zh: 对，非常明智，非常精明。

sentences.en: OK, so what what led you to wanting to pursue a career in psychology?
sentences.zh: 好的，那是什么促使你想追求心理学职业的？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So basically, as a kid, I used to always split from job to job in terms of like a dream career, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，我小时候，在理想职业方面总是换来换去，你知道的。

sentences.en: So I used to think, oh, I want to be a baker.
sentences.zh: 所以以前我会想，哦，我想当个面包师。

sentences.en: OK, never mind.
sentences.zh: 好吧，当我没说。

sentences.en: I want to be a movie director.
sentences.zh: 我想当电影导演。

sentences.en: I actually want to be a video game creator.
sentences.zh: 其实我还想当电子游戏创作者。

sentences.en: So like I thought of like so many different things.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想过好多不同的东西。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And then like high school hit like towards almost the end of high school.
sentences.zh: 然后高中就来了，差不多到高中快结束的时候。

sentences.en: And I was still not even sure what I wanted to do, like as a job, as a career, what what you know, what the major to go into university.
sentences.zh: 我还是不确定自己想做什么工作，想把什么当作职业，你知道的，上大学该选什么专业。

sentences.en: Like none of that.
sentences.zh: 什么都不确定。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Honestly, like I was so behind and then basically like it was basically kind of two factors.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我当时落后太多了，然后基本上算是有两个因素吧。

sentences.en: But the first one was when I signed up for to do AP psychology, the advanced placement psychology that my school was like offering.
sentences.zh: 但第一个因素是我报名参加了学校开设的AP心理学，也就是大学先修课程心理学。

sentences.en: You know, they offered APs back then.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们那时候提供AP课程。

sentences.en: So I would.
sentences.zh: 所以我就会。

sentences.en: So I chose to do AP psychology.
sentences.zh: 所以我选择修AP心理学。

sentences.en: But the thing is also what's it called?
sentences.zh: 但问题是，那个叫什么来着？

sentences.en: It's a self-study AP.
sentences.zh: 这是一门自学的AP课程。

sentences.en: So I didn't have a teacher.
sentences.zh: 所以我没有老师。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I'm just studying by myself and what the school like offered me.
sentences.zh: 我就是靠自己学习学校提供给我的东西。

sentences.en: So maybe sometimes they'd offer exams or, you know, chapters of like the Barron's book to read, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以有时候他们可能会提供考试，或者你知道的，巴伦（Barron's）教材的章节来阅读。

sentences.en: So they'd make sure like, OK, you're reading everything.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会确保，好吧，你把所有东西都读了。

sentences.en: But they were also not that serious at the same time because it was post-COVID.
sentences.zh: 但他们当时也不是那么严肃，因为那是疫情之后。

sentences.en: And, you know, everybody was just like just lacking in terms of their efforts at school.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，大家在学校的努力程度都有所欠缺。

sentences.en: So like it was both like half half from what this from what my school side was offering and advanced placement, by the way, like a side note, it's a it's a it's the equivalent,
sentences.zh: 所以这可以说是学校提供的内容和大学先修课程各占一半，顺便提一下，它相当于——

sentences.en: the American equivalent to a British A-level.
sentences.zh: 美国相当于英国的A-level课程。

sentences.en: So they're basically kind of the same thing.
sentences.zh: 所以它们基本上差不多。

sentences.en: If you're going to American universities, generally speaking, they might ask for APs.
sentences.zh: 如果你要去美国大学，一般来说，他们可能会要求提供AP成绩。

sentences.en: Obviously, if you're going to UK universities, they might ask for A-levels.
sentences.zh: 显然，如果你去英国大学，他们可能会要求A-level成绩。

sentences.en: So it's like sort of like an equivalent issue.
sentences.zh: 所以这有点像是对等的。

sentences.en: But basically, AP psychology, that was like a first thing really helped, to be totally honest, because it like offered me so much insight into it.
sentences.zh: 但基本上，AP心理学真的是帮了大忙的第一件事，老实说，因为它让我对这门学科有了深入的了解。

sentences.en: I was studying from like the Barron's book, Princeton book, like lots of sources as well, just for that one exam.
sentences.zh: 我当时读的是巴伦书、普林斯顿书，为了那场考试参考了好多资料。

sentences.en: And it like really like informed me, of course,
sentences.zh: 它确实让我大开眼界，当然了。

sentences.en: of what psychology actually was and different types of it and different even some sometimes different self-defense mechanisms I learned from Barron's and like for the AP,
sentences.zh: 让我知道了心理学到底是什么，不同的分支，甚至我还从巴伦和AP考试中学到了一些不同的自我防御机制。

sentences.en: for the advanced placement exam.
sentences.zh: 为了大学先修课程考试。

sentences.en: Like a lot.
sentences.zh: 学到了很多。

sentences.en: I learned countless like so much valuable info just from that from that from that advanced placement exam.
sentences.zh: 仅仅通过那个大学先修课程考试，我就学到了无数非常有价值的信息。

sentences.en: I still have like my books.
sentences.zh: 我的书现在还留着。

sentences.en: It's been two years and I still have my books from them from the AP because I just like cherish it that much.
sentences.zh: 已经过去两年了，我依然留着AP的那些书，因为我太珍惜它们了。

sentences.en: But a second thing other than the AP was like my own personal like struggles with mental health.
sentences.zh: 但除了AP之外的第二件事，就是我自己对心理健康的苦苦挣扎。

sentences.en: Like it sounds even redundant at this point, but I like genuinely like back then, you know, I struggled with like overthinking or, you know, like, you know,
sentences.zh: 现在听起来甚至有点多余，但我发自内心地说，当时，你知道的，我一直在跟过度思考作斗争，或者你知道的，你知道的——

sentences.en: having like sort of like body insecurities, if you can call it that.
sentences.zh: 对身材有些容貌焦虑，如果可以这么叫的话。

sentences.en: And like, you know, and later on, as time went on, especially two years ago, I, you know, I formed a much better like perception of myself, did better habits.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，后来随着时间推移，尤其是两年前，我对自己有了好得多的认知，养成了更好的习惯。

sentences.en: And I was wondering like what I could do because I knew people around me as well that suffered either mentally or emotionally or whatnot.
sentences.zh: 我在想我能做点什么，因为我也知道身边有人在心理或情感上遭受痛苦之类的事情。

sentences.en: So I was wondering like, okay, what if I could attribute this, what I've done for myself, even if it's just a life coach way to help other people and like, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以我一直在想，好吧，如果我能把自己做过的事，哪怕只是通过生活教练的方式去帮助别人，你知道的——

sentences.en: spread some goodness or knowledge.
sentences.zh: 传播一些善意或知识。

sentences.en: So I learned whether psychology or just from my own like introspection or experiences, what could I do to like to say to not save people's lives,
sentences.zh: 所以我通过心理学或者我自己的内省和经历了解到，我能做些什么来，不能说是拯救别人的生命——

sentences.en: but even like sometimes critical psychologists do save people's lives.
sentences.zh: 但有时专业的心理学家确实能拯救别人的生命。

sentences.en: So I also thought about, you know, how do I help people mentally diagnosing disorders and preventing suicides?
sentences.zh: 所以我也在想，如何通过诊断心理障碍和预防自杀来在精神上帮助别人？

sentences.en: Like I thought that stuff was would be extremely fulfilling for me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这些事情会让我感到极其充实。

sentences.en: So it's both the advanced placement and my own personal experiences and experiences of people around that maybe want to pursue psychology.
sentences.zh: 所以这既有大学先修课程的原因，也有我自己的亲身经历，以及身边可能想学心理学的人的经历。

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Well, thank you for sharing that, because I think it's always interesting thinking about what brings us to the profession.
sentences.zh: 好吧，谢谢你分享这些，因为我觉得思考是什么把我们带入这个行业的总是很有趣。

sentences.en: And speaking as a Middle Eastern man, how is mental health handled or considered or referred to by people, you know, around you?
sentences.zh: 作为一名中东男性，你周围的人是如何看待、称呼或处理心理健康问题的？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: OK, so it totally depends from country to country, to be honest, because I feel like the UAE is much more open in terms of inviting international people and employees,
sentences.zh: 好吧，说实话，这完全取决于不同的国家，因为我觉得阿联酋在吸引国际人才和员工方面要开放得多。

sentences.en: which obviously how Birmingham Dubai exists, it's obviously from another country.
sentences.zh: 显然伯明翰大学迪拜分校就是这样存在的，它显然来自另一个国家。

sentences.en: But, you know, they managed to make the whole university here and lots of the same programs and everything.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，他们设法在这里建起了整所大学以及许多相同的项目和一切。

sentences.en: Even obviously some staff from from England, for example, are working here.
sentences.zh: 甚至显然还有一些来自英国的教职员工在这里工作。

sentences.en: So it depends from country to country.
sentences.zh: 所以这因国家而异。

sentences.en: The UAE is like has been really good.
sentences.zh: 阿联酋真的很棒。

sentences.en: I feel like in my personal opinion, from what I know anyway, at, you know, having more psychology programs and allowing more people to teach psychology.
sentences.zh: 依我个人之见，据我所知，它拥有更多的心理学项目，并允许更多的人教授心理学。

sentences.en: But but for example, in a country like where I'm from, I'm from Syria in Syria, like mental health is like barely discussed.
sentences.zh: 但例如，在我老家这样的国家，我是叙利亚人，在叙利亚，心理健康几乎是个禁忌。

sentences.en: Lots of people don't really know about it.
sentences.zh: 很多人其实并不了解它。

sentences.en: Some people might like feel really bad, but maybe they'll just attribute to religion or I have no friends or, you know, like no social, no active social life.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能会感觉非常糟糕，但也许他们只会归咎于宗教信仰，或者我没有朋友，你知道的，没有社交，没有活跃的社交生活。

sentences.en: Or maybe they just like have bad habits or something.
sentences.zh: 或者也许他们只是觉得是自己有什么坏习惯之类的。

sentences.en: They don't really like acknowledge like, OK, maybe it's this habit or it's this disorder that's causing this thing.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有真正意识到，好吧，也许正是这种习惯或这种心理障碍导致了这种情况。

sentences.en: And, you know, we'll try to work from there or maybe it's this medication you need.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们会试着从那里着手解决，或者也许你需要这种药物。

sentences.en: Like Syria, it's not really that common.
sentences.zh: 就像在叙利亚，这并不是很常见。

sentences.en: I know someone personally, a woman personally from Syria, because we've been having us.
sentences.zh: 我个人认识叙利亚的一个人，一个女人，因为我们一直遭遇——

sentences.en: We have had the civil war for like years now.
sentences.zh: 我们已经经历内战好多年了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So her son actually would sometimes scream in the middle of the night, like literally post-traumatic stress disorder,
sentences.zh: 所以实际上她的儿子有时会在半夜尖叫，这简直就是创伤后应激障碍（PTSD），

sentences.en: would literally scream in the middle of the night because like he would hear like bombs like before as a as a really young kid.
sentences.zh: 会在半夜字面意义上地尖叫，因为他小时候经历过听到轰炸声那种事。

sentences.en: And then she told me like they'd go to a psychiatrist and they'd give him medication, but it wouldn't really help out for the long term.
sentences.zh: 然后她告诉我，他们会去看精神科医生，医生会给他开药，但这从长远来看并没有真正起到太大作用。

sentences.en: And then he then he would just keep doing the same behavior.
sentences.zh: 然后他还是会继续有那种行为。

sentences.en: So it really depends.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的因人而异。

sentences.en: Like Syria, the situation there is just not that been good from a psychology standpoint.
sentences.zh: 就像叙利亚，从心理学的角度来看，那里的情况一直不太好。

sentences.en: The UAE, it's been really good.
sentences.zh: 阿联酋则一直很好。

sentences.en: And I think I can't be sure, of course, but I think some other countries, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, they've been better,
sentences.zh: 我想——虽然我不能完全确定，但我觉得其他一些国家，比如沙特阿拉伯、埃及，情况也更好了，

sentences.en: like in terms of employing more psychologists and stuff like that, getting more people from abroad to teach in those countries.
sentences.zh: 在聘用更多心理学家等方面，从国外引进更多人才去这些国家教书。

sentences.en: But it's still like not as good or not as advanced as somewhere like America, Germany, the UK.
sentences.zh: 但它仍然不像美国、德国、英国那样优秀或先进。

sentences.en: And of course, another thing to add is that the psychology standpoint and knowledge is so much better nowadays in the Middle East compared to like 20 years ago, 15 years ago.
sentences.zh: 当然，还要补充的一点是，如今中东的心理学观点和知识比20年前、15年前要好得多。

sentences.en: People would just barely even know of it, let alone bring it up.
sentences.zh: 人们以前甚至几乎不知道它，更不用说提起了。

sentences.en: But like now it's becoming much better.
sentences.zh: 但现在情况好多了。

sentences.en: People are getting more aware.
sentences.zh: 人们的意识正在提高。

sentences.en: Life coaches, for example, are kind of helping it out, even if it's not necessarily psychologists.
sentences.zh: 例如，生活教练在一定程度上正在提供帮助，即使他们不一定是心理学家。

sentences.en: Life coaches, for example, they do kind of bring up all mental health is this, how to do good habits is that.
sentences.zh: 例如，生活教练确实会提起什么是心理健康，如何养成好习惯之类的话题。

sentences.en: And, you know, life coaches are helping out as well.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，生活教练也在提供帮助。

sentences.en: But I know personally some Arab life coaches from people I know that they've told me, oh, this guy's really good.
sentences.zh: 但我个人从我认识的人那里了解到一些阿拉伯生活教练，他们告诉我，这个人真的很棒。

sentences.en: This one's really good.
sentences.zh: 这个真的很棒。

sentences.en: But psychology, it's improving, but it's still not there yet, you know, not like America, UK, Austria, so on.
sentences.zh: 但心理学虽然在进步，但还没达到那种程度，你知道的，比不上美国、英国、奥地利等等。

sentences.en: Yeah, so it sounds like some of our Western approaches to mental health are sort of filtering through.
sentences.zh: 对，所以听起来我们的一些西方心理健康方法正在渗透进来。

sentences.en: And certainly with the UK universities being present on the soil, that might well speed that up a bit as well.
sentences.zh: 而且英国大学进驻当地，肯定也会在一定程度上加速这一进程。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I don't even have much to add to it because, you know, the UK having their universities here, I feel like it's also helping quite a bit.
sentences.zh: 我甚至没有什么好补充的，因为你知道，英国的大学把校区开到这里，我觉得也起到了相当大的推动作用。

sentences.en: Like, I think even 10 years ago or so, 15 years ago, the UAE didn't have one single psychology degree, if I'm not mistaken.
sentences.zh: 比如，我觉得甚至在10年前左右、15年前，如果我没记错的话，阿联酋连一个心理学学位都没有。

sentences.en: So now it's getting, like, it's accelerating.
sentences.zh: 所以现在它正在加速发展。

sentences.en: Yeah, yes, building its momentum for sure.
sentences.zh: 对，是的，它确实在蓄势待发。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And once you've done your undergraduate degree, have you got an idea about what you might do next?
sentences.zh: 当你完成了本科学位后，对下一步有什么打算吗？

sentences.en: That's such a good question.
sentences.zh: 真是个好问题。

sentences.en: So I'm really fascinated by clinical psychology for sure, diagnosing disorders and like really going in depth,
sentences.zh: 我对临床心理学绝对是着迷的，诊断各种障碍，并且深入研究，

sentences.en: like something like a social worker or a mental health counselor wouldn't possibly wouldn't do.
sentences.zh: 这是社会工作者或心理健康顾问可能不会做的事情。

sentences.en: So I would want to, like, go more in depth and tackle more, like, serious trauma, more long-term stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望能够更深入地研究，处理更严重的创伤、更长期的心理问题。

sentences.en: I kind of thought that psychiatry, like, is sort of the same thing, but I thought it didn't really appeal to me as much because I don't want to have, like,
sentences.zh: 我曾以为精神病学差不多是同一回事，但我发现它对我没有那么大的吸引力，因为我不想进行那种浅尝辄止的会面，然后只给开点药。

sentences.en: shallow sessions and just give medication.
sentences.zh: 我只想开点药。

sentences.en: And I thought I wanted to, like, form, like, good relationships with clients, of course, only during the time.
sentences.zh: 我以为我想和来访者建立良好的关系，当然，仅限于这段时间。

sentences.en: Of course, you can't talk, as far as I'm aware, you can't talk with, socialize with your clients during and after sessions, you know, like, oh, yeah, did you go to this restaurant?
sentences.zh: 当然，据我所知，在会面期间和之后你不能跟来访者闲聊、社交，比如，“哦，对啦，你去过那家餐厅吗？太棒了。”

sentences.en: So nice.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Like, no, you have to only talk in the office.
sentences.zh: 就像，不行，你们只能在办公室里交谈。

sentences.en: So I would, like, personally love doing that.
sentences.zh: 所以我个人非常乐意做这件事。

sentences.en: And also because, like, I'm a Muslim, I learned quite a bit about Islamic psychology.
sentences.zh: 而且因为我是一名穆斯林，我对伊斯兰心理学也有了一定的了解。

sentences.en: And honestly, it also seems, like, really interesting to me how, like, faith and psychology are actually intertwined and, like,
sentences.zh: 老实说，信仰与心理学实际上是如何交织在一起的，以及信仰如何加速或恶化某人的心理健康，这也让我觉得非常有趣。

sentences.en: how faith can either accelerate or worsen someone's mental health.
sentences.zh: 信仰如何加速或恶化某人的心理健康。

sentences.en: I feel like faith is just generally not discussed, like, Muslim or otherwise, how, like,
sentences.zh: 我觉得信仰通常没有被讨论过，无论是穆斯林还是其他人，比如其他人可能心里受过创伤，或者他们有错误的认知，或者你知道的，他们在信仰方面可能出了点问题。

sentences.en: maybe other people might just be mentally scarred or maybe they have wrong perceptions or maybe, you know, they might just have something wrong in terms of their faith.
sentences.zh: 也许这正是没有得到解决的问题。

sentences.en: And maybe that's what's, like, not being addressed.
sentences.zh: 也许这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: Because generally, from what I've learned, psychology doesn't really address impacts that things like religion have.
sentences.zh: 因为总的来说，据我了解，心理学并没有真正解决宗教等事物所产生的影响。

sentences.en: So Islamic psychology would be, like, really interesting to delve into.
sentences.zh: 所以深入研究伊斯兰心理学将会非常有趣。

sentences.en: So it's either clinical or Islamic, though I've always thought more about clinical and I'm more familiar with clinical.
sentences.zh: 所以要么是临床心理学，要么是伊斯兰心理学，虽然我一直更多地考虑临床心理学，而且我也对临床更熟悉。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: Could you tell us a bit more about Islamic psychology, if you can?
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，能跟我们多讲讲伊斯兰心理学吗？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I'm not an Islamic psychologist myself, but essentially, if I'm not wrong.
sentences.zh: 我本身不是伊斯兰心理学家，但基本上，如果我没弄错的话。

sentences.en: So basically, in Islam, we believe that there's four things.
sentences.zh: 所以在伊斯兰教中，我们相信有四件事。

sentences.en: Like, I speak from a Muslim also.
sentences.zh: 我是从一个穆斯林的视角来说的。

sentences.en: We usually have four things, like, to take care of.
sentences.zh: 我们通常有四件事需要照顾。

sentences.en: So we have the heart, which is basically your emotions, which means qalb in Arabic.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有心，也就是你的情绪，在阿拉伯语里是 qalb。

sentences.en: Like, jasad, or the body.
sentences.zh: 就像 jasad，也就是身体。

sentences.en: So, like, you know, your physical self.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，你的物理实体。

sentences.en: Ruh, which is your spirit.
sentences.zh: Ruh，也就是你的精神。

sentences.en: So, like, you know, spiritually.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，在精神层面上。

sentences.en: And also, so the heart, the soul, and the mind.
sentences.zh: 还有，心、灵魂和思想。

sentences.en: So, mentally.
sentences.zh: 所以，在精神层面。

sentences.en: So you basically have spiritual, emotional, physical, mental.
sentences.zh: 所以你基本上有精神、情感、身体和心理四个维度。

sentences.en: So you have these four aspects that are intertwined to make, like, a good, you know, being.
sentences.zh: 所以你有这四个交织在一起的方面，才能成就一个优秀的，你知道的人。

sentences.en: A good being and a role model.
sentences.zh: 一个优秀的人和榜样。

sentences.en: And someone that would do in this life.
sentences.zh: 以及一个在今世有所作为的人。

sentences.en: And in Islam, we also believe that there's a next life, either heaven or hell.
sentences.zh: 在伊斯兰教中，我们也相信有来世，也就是天堂或地狱。

sentences.en: So that we believe.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的信仰。

sentences.en: So, for example, if I have really good relationships and I have a good spiritual health.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果我的人际关系非常好，并且身心精神健康都很不错。

sentences.en: So maybe I'm practicing my religion all the time.
sentences.zh: 也许我一直在践行我的宗教信仰。

sentences.en: But I have horrible physical health.
sentences.zh: 但我身体健康状况极差。

sentences.en: So I'm always going to doctors.
sentences.zh: 总是要去医院看医生。

sentences.en: And I have, you know, I'm always getting really tired.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，我总是感到非常疲惫。

sentences.en: And maybe I'm a smoking addict.
sentences.zh: 也许我还烟瘾很大。

sentences.en: So, you know, I can't feel relaxed without a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 所以，没有烟的话我就无法放松。

sentences.en: So basically, like, these.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上就是这样。

sentences.en: So basically, this doesn't really constitute a full, like, human being in wellness.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，这并不算是一个真正健康的全人。

sentences.en: Because the physical part is always taking away from the other parts as well.
sentences.zh: 因为身体上的问题一直在削弱其他各方面的状态。

sentences.en: And it's worsening your overall, like, existence in this life.
sentences.zh: 并且它还在恶化你在这世上的整体生存状态。

sentences.en: So, you know, you might be worse off in sports or other physical activities or, you know, outings with family or friends.
sentences.zh: 所以，你可能会在运动、其他体力活动、或者与家人朋友的外出聚会中表现得更糟。

sentences.en: So that's why, for example, all four of these, like, generally speaking, in Islamic psychology, must be, like, must be considered.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么，举个例子，在伊斯兰心理学中，总的来说这四个方面都必须被考虑到。

sentences.en: Not just physical, mental, emotional.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是生理、心理和情感。

sentences.en: Like, the spiritual is also important.
sentences.zh: 精神层面同样非常重要。

sentences.en: So obviously, maybe sometimes from an Islamic scholar's point of view, maybe you have these three aspects.
sentences.zh: 显然，有时从伊斯兰学者的角度来看，你可能具备了这三个方面。

sentences.en: But the spiritual isn't up to par.
sentences.zh: 但精神层面却没有达到标准。

sentences.en: So maybe you're going to need to practice more in order to feel actually more fulfilled and then have a good, like, well-being overall, all these four.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能需要进行更多的修炼，才能真正感到更加充实，并在所有这四个方面都获得良好的整体幸福感。

sentences.en: Spiritual, physical, mental, emotional.
sentences.zh: 精神、身体、心理、情感。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: That's really interesting as an idea.
sentences.zh: 这个想法真的很有趣。

sentences.en: And I guess you might have heard me talk about on the podcast before.
sentences.zh: 我想你以前可能听我在播客里说过。

sentences.en: It's like having your ducks in a row or at least knowing which ducks it is you're trying to tame, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这就好比把你的事情都安排妥当，或者至少知道你试图驯服的是哪几只“鸭子”，不是吗？

sentences.en: You know, and, you know, yeah, when we look at Maslow's hierarchy, you know, if your health is impaired, that's going to really impact on your ability to move up that pyramid.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当我们审视马斯洛的需求层次时，如果你的健康受损，那将严重影响你向金字塔上一层攀登的能力。

sentences.en: It's also interlinked.
sentences.zh: 它们也是相互关联的。

sentences.en: So I really like that explicit focus on those four areas.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的很喜欢对这四个领域的明确关注。

sentences.en: You know, and I think sometimes when we when we've got some of our ducks in a row or if you've got three of those areas that are actually looking pretty, pretty good, pretty shiny,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我认为有时当我们把事情都理清了，或者如果你有其中三个领域看起来相当不错、相当理想时，

sentences.en: it does then perhaps give you the impetus to think, let's see what we can do about that fourth one.
sentences.zh: 它确实会给你一种动力去思考，让我们看看能为第四个领域做些什么。

sentences.en: Let's see how we can to get that more in line with with the others where I want to be,
sentences.zh: 让我们看看如何使它更符合其他几个领域，达到我期望的状态，

sentences.en: because it might be holding me back from my goals or stopping me from being as well as I can be.
sentences.zh: 因为这可能正在阻碍我实现目标，或者阻止我达到我所能达到的最佳状态。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，完全正确。

sentences.en: So maybe, for example, you might you might always be devoted to your relationships, but then your mental health,
sentences.zh: 所以比如，你可能一直全身心投入到人际关系中，但你的心理健康状况

sentences.en: it might be bad because maybe you might be more people pleasing or maybe you just do or say things that you normally wouldn't do just for the emotional aspect and not the mental one.
sentences.zh: 可能会变差，因为你可能更倾向于讨好他人，或者仅仅为了情感层面而非心理层面去做或说一些你平时不会做的话。

sentences.en: So you're just ignoring your your mental health and your own sense of peace.
sentences.zh: 所以你只是忽视了你的心理健康和内心的平静。

sentences.en: You know, that's that's another thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是另一回事。

sentences.en: So they're all related in Islamic psychology, even clinical, obviously, but usually clinical psychologists exclude the spiritual.
sentences.zh: 所以在伊斯兰心理学中，它们都是相关的，临床心理学显然也相关，但通常临床心理学家会排除精神层面。

sentences.en: So Islamic psychology considers the spiritual as well as the other three, not just spiritual and not just other three.
sentences.zh: 因此，伊斯兰心理学既考虑精神层面，也考虑其他三个层面，不只是精神层面，也不只是其他三个层面。

sentences.en: So it's all for it.
sentences.zh: 所以这四个方面兼顾。

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: And I think it's OK to combine the two.
sentences.zh: 我认为把这两者结合起来是可以的。

sentences.en: I think it's OK for you to be an Islamic clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为你成为一名伊斯兰临床心理学家是可以的。

sentences.en: So, of course, certainly when we're working in the NHS, you know, we're not using faith interventions, but I think it's absolutely OK to talk about, you know, well,
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，我们在英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）工作时，不会使用信仰干预，但我认为完全可以谈论，

sentences.en: I understand as a, you know, an Islamic male or Muslim or whatever you want to introduce yourself as.
sentences.zh: 作为一个伊斯兰男性、穆斯林，或者任何你想用以介绍自己的身份，我是这样理解的。

sentences.en: As I understand it, this is this is this is the learnings of my faith.
sentences.zh: 据我所理解，这就是我的信仰所教导的。

sentences.en: This is how we understand it.
sentences.zh: 我们就是这样理解的。

sentences.en: But you're not saying you should do this.
sentences.zh: 但你并不是在说你应该这样做。

sentences.en: You should do that.
sentences.zh: 你应该那样做。

sentences.en: You're offering clients in different way of looking at things to see if things resonate with them.
sentences.zh: 你是在为来访者提供一种不同的视角，看看某些观点是否能引起他们的共鸣。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I am OK with bringing myself to therapy.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我赞成在治疗中展现真实的自我。

sentences.en: So, you know, I'm not sharing my woes.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不是在倾倒苦水。

sentences.en: I'm not, you know, I'm not sharing all this deep personal information, but I will happily share that I'm a parent and I'm a parent of two boys, you know, and I'm married.
sentences.zh: 我没有分享所有这些深度的个人隐私，但我很乐意分享我是一个父母，是两个男孩的父亲，而且我已婚。

sentences.en: And, you know, you might well know from listening to the podcast that my dad died in 2017.
sentences.zh: 而且听过播客的人可能都知道，我的父亲在2017年去世了。

sentences.en: So I'm happy to share that basic information with clients if it's relevant, you know, because I think it helps you to be a human first and a psychologist second.
sentences.zh: 所以如果相关的话，我很乐意与来访者分享这些基本信息，因为我认为这有助于让你先成为一个有人情味的人，其次才是一个心理学家。

sentences.en: And because it just offers you some context and makes you feel more like a tangible human rather than some robotic therapist, you know.
sentences.zh: 这能提供一些背景，让你感觉更像一个真实可感的人，而不是一个机器人治疗师。

sentences.en: So as you go through your training,
sentences.zh: 所以在你完成培训的过程中，

sentences.en: you might well develop some competence and confidence in just weaving in appropriate amounts of yourself into the work you do with people without it being all about you because it shouldn't be all about us.
sentences.zh: 你可能会逐渐培养出一种能力和自信，在与人们的工作中适度融入你自己的经历，而不是把话题全变成关于你自己的，因为这不应该全部关于我们。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I sometimes think that I'm like, OK, maybe I've seen before some therapists say or that, you know, maybe something that therapists can sometimes do not always,
sentences.zh: 有时我想，我以前看到过有些治疗师说，或者治疗师有时会做——虽然不是总是这样，

sentences.en: but sometimes do is they bring up their own details so that the clients can resonate with them.
sentences.zh: 但有时会谈到他们自己的细节，以便让来访者与他们产生共鸣。

sentences.en: But not to the point where the therapist becomes like the client and they switch roles like no,
sentences.zh: 但不到那种让治疗师变得像来访者、两人互换角色的程度，不，

sentences.en: like the therapist can sometimes say some details of one or two or something so that the client can like relate to them or think like, OK, this is a normal human being thing.
sentences.zh: 治疗师有时会说出一两个细节，以便来访者能够与他们产生联系，或者觉得“哦，这是一个正常人都会有的经历”。

sentences.en: And it's totally fine to feel this way or to have something that happened this way.
sentences.zh: 有这种感受或经历这样的事是完全正常的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And actually a good catchphrase to use if you don't want to use self-disclosure is, you know, other clients I've worked with have found that or lots of people have told me that or,
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果你不想使用自我披露，一个很好的常用语是，我共事过的其他来访者也发现过这一点，或者很多人对我说过，或者，

sentences.en: you know, I wonder if you might consider the ideas from Islam that tells us about this.
sentences.zh: 我在想你是否可以考虑一下伊斯兰教中关于这方面的观点。

sentences.en: But you're not actually saying this is what I say or this is what I believe.
sentences.zh: 但你实际上并没有说这就是我的看法或这就是我的信仰。

sentences.en: You're just, you know, introducing that there might be different viewpoints.
sentences.zh: 你只是在引入可能存在不同观点的可能性。

sentences.en: So certainly in dynamic psychology and psychotherapy, you wouldn't use any level of self-disclosure at all.
sentences.zh: 所以在动态心理学和心理治疗中，你绝对不会使用任何程度的自我披露。

sentences.en: But it's got to feel comfortable to you and authentic, you know, so we're not sharing more than we feel comfortable with, really.
sentences.zh: 但这必须让你感到舒适和真实，所以我们不会分享超出我们舒适范围的内容。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: Yeah, I fully agree.
sentences.zh: 对，我完全赞同。

sentences.en: Like you wouldn't want to just overbear on the client and sometimes, you know, bringing extra details from yourself might be embarrassing on your part.
sentences.zh: 就像你不会希望对来访者过度施压一样，有时引入你自己的额外细节可能会让你感到尴尬。

sentences.en: So, you know, bringing like an external source of this, these therapists also think that, you know, you know, you should do this thing and so on.
sentences.zh: 所以引入一个外部来源，比如“这些治疗师也认为你应该这样做”等等。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: So, you know, in terms of whatever role you end up pursuing, it's often really useful to have relevant experience roles.
sentences.zh: 所以，无论你最终追求什么角色，拥有相关的经验通常都非常有用。

sentences.en: So have you got plans to start doing some sort of clinically-ish relevant work on the side of your degree or, you know, roles that you might think about applying for?
sentences.zh: 那么，你是否有计划在学位之余做一些临床相关的工作，或者有哪些你可能会考虑申请的职位？

sentences.en: It probably feels quite distant.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能还很遥远。

sentences.en: We're talking about four years time, but have you got roles you're considering or would consider?
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是四年后的事情，但你有没有正在考虑或会考虑的职位？

sentences.en: Like in terms of just internships, you mean, right?
sentences.zh: 你是说像实习之类的吗？

sentences.en: So in this country, we might have support work in psychiatric hospitals or home care or teaching assistant or assistant psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以在我们国家，我们可能会有精神病院的支持工作、家庭护理、助教或心理学助理。

sentences.en: There's a whole, you know, psychological well-being practitioners.
sentences.zh: 还有各种心理健康从业者。

sentences.en: I don't know if that training has yet started coming to the Middle East, but there's a whole variety of relevant experience.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这种培训是否已经开始引入中东，但相关经验的选择非常多样。

sentences.en: And I guess I wonder what the flavor of that kind of work is looking like at the moment.
sentences.zh: 我想知道目前这类工作的倾向是怎样的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So basically, like in the Middle East, like I've said, unfortunately, there's not as much experience as in the UK.
sentences.zh: 基本上，就像我说的，在中东，不幸的是，不像在英国那样有那么多经验机会。

sentences.en: Even getting jobs.
sentences.zh: 甚至找工作也是如此。

sentences.en: Sometimes I've heard even for like, because I live in the UAE, of course.
sentences.zh: 有时我听说，因为我当然住在阿联酋，

sentences.en: So sometimes even for national students, it's a bit hard to always get a job on the spot.
sentences.zh: 所以有时即使对本国学生来说，想要立刻找到一份工作也有点难。

sentences.en: Sometimes you need connections or mutuals or that, you know, can get you a job.
sentences.zh: 有时你需要人脉或共同的朋友才能帮你找到工作。

sentences.en: Sometimes you really need like a qualification.
sentences.zh: 有时你真的需要资格证书。

sentences.en: You really need the university degree in order for people to accept you.
sentences.zh: 你真的需要大学学位才能让别人录用你。

sentences.en: So there's, I swear, I think I've seen personally, I think I've seen maybe only one person under 18 that's actually been able to find a job.
sentences.zh: 所以，我发誓，我个人好像只见过一个18岁以下的人真正找到了工作。

sentences.en: Other than that, though, generally speaking, like internships aren't that easy to find here.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，总的来说，实习在这里没那么容易找到。

sentences.en: Maybe if the university offers you something directly, like, you know, volunteering, for example.
sentences.zh: 也许如果大学直接为你提供一些机会，比如做志愿者。

sentences.en: I don't know if this volunteering considered like summer internship work in the UK.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这种志愿者工作在英国是否被视为暑期实习工作。

sentences.en: So honorary experience is absolutely relevant.
sentences.zh: 因此，无薪荣誉职位绝对是相关的。

sentences.en: But what can sometimes be tricky with honorary experience is that sometimes it's fewer hours a week because, of course, people need to be able to make a living.
sentences.zh: 但无薪荣誉经验有时比较棘手的一点是，每周的工作时间可能较少，因为人们毕竟需要谋生。

sentences.en: And so when we're looking at counting how many months or full time equivalent months people have had,
sentences.zh: 所以当我们计算人们拥有多少个月或全职当量的月数经验时，

sentences.en: it sometimes takes a lot of work to even, you know, add up to a couple of months.
sentences.zh: 有时要凑满几个月都需要做大量的工作。

sentences.en: And so that's why it can be deemed as less favourable, because unless you're working full time every day for free, you know, five days a week,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么它可能被认为不太有利，因为除非你每天无偿全职工作，每周五天，

sentences.en: which many people can't and shouldn't have to afford to do, then it's tricky to get the same amount of experience, if that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 而许多人做不到也不应该负担得起这样做，否则很难获得等量的经验，这么说你能理解吗？

sentences.en: So, you know, it's very much useful.
sentences.zh: 所以，这非常有用。

sentences.en: So I did an honorary assistant post, and I did that by taking a day a week of annual leave from my paid role over 10 weeks, so 10 days.
sentences.zh: 我曾担任过一个荣誉助理职位，我是通过在10周内从我的带薪职位中每周请一天年假来完成的，也就是10天。

sentences.en: But whilst on paper, that didn't look like that's not even a month, you know, but actually in terms of my life, that was, you know, three-ish months,
sentences.zh: 虽然在纸面上看起来这甚至不到一个月，但实际上在我的生活中，那是大约三个月的时间，

sentences.en: maybe even going on for four, depending on how spaced out it was.
sentences.zh: 根据时间间隔的长远，甚至可能接近四个月。

sentences.en: But in terms of my understanding about psychology and my confidence in talking about psychology and psychology terms and, you know,
sentences.zh: 但就我对心理学的理解、谈论心理学和心理学术语的自信而言，以及

sentences.en: having a reference to put on my form that was a clinical psychologist and, you know,
sentences.zh: 在表格上可以填写的由临床心理学家撰写的推荐信，

sentences.en: just my confidence in talking about all of that stuff and feeling like I could talk the talk and walk the walk.
sentences.zh: 还有我谈论这一切的自信，以及觉得自己能够言行一致。

sentences.en: So in terms of what I got from those 10 days, I would say it was massive.
sentences.zh: 所以就我从那10天里获得的东西而言，我认为是巨大的。

sentences.en: But on paper, it looked like less than a month's experience.
sentences.zh: 但在纸面上，它看起来像不到一个月的经验。

sentences.en: So we don't always do it for how many months on our form it looks like.
sentences.zh: 所以我们并不是总是为了表格上看起来有多少个月的经验而去做这件事。

sentences.en: We do it for the massive leaps and bounds that it helps bring on our development.
sentences.zh: 我们是为了它能给我们带来的巨大跨越和发展而去做这件事。

sentences.en: So, you know, I couldn't at that time afford to not be working, but I decided I could take the hit of having two weeks less annual leave that year.
sentences.zh: 所以，当时我无法承担不工作的代价，但我决定承受那一年少两周年假的代价。

sentences.en: So, you know, still a little bit more rubbish because for the rest of the year I had less annual leave.
sentences.zh: 所以，这其实有点糟糕，因为在今年剩下的时间里我的年假变少了。

sentences.en: But actually being in that role really energised me anyway.
sentences.zh: 但实际上身处那个岗位确实让我充满了活力。

sentences.en: I loved doing that.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢做那件事。

sentences.en: And so I felt like it was worth it.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉这一切都是值得的。

sentences.en: Wait, so you worked for 10 days over a span of almost four months.
sentences.zh: 等等，所以你在近四个月的时间里工作了10天。

sentences.en: But you still say that, like, even though it might have been really exhausting or draining, it still really helped you out even till now?
sentences.zh: 但你仍然说，尽管这可能非常令人筋疲力尽或精疲力竭，但它对你的帮助一直持续到现在？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I was working for a local government.
sentences.zh: 当时我为地方政府工作。

sentences.en: I was working for the council.
sentences.zh: 我为市议会工作。

sentences.en: So I'd usually work Mondays to Fridays, you know, nine to five.
sentences.zh: 我通常从周一到周五工作，早上九点到下午五点。

sentences.en: But I'd negotiated with my, basically, I knew of a clinical psychologist that was sort of working with some of my clients.
sentences.zh: 但我跟——基本上，我认识一位临床心理学家，她当时正和我的某些来访者合作。

sentences.en: And so I'd emailed her and said, is there any chance you'd consider taking me on in an honorary cabal, take some annual leave?
sentences.zh: 所以我给她发了电子邮件，问她是否有可能会考虑让我担任一个荣誉职位，我可以请年假。

sentences.en: And we wrangled a bit.
sentences.zh: 我们商量了一番。

sentences.en: And then eventually she said yes.
sentences.zh: 最后她同意了。

sentences.en: So, yeah,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，

sentences.en: I then negotiated with my workspace to allow me to be essentially part time for 10 weeks so that I could take every Monday off to go and work under a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 然后我和我的工作单位协商，允许我在10周内基本上做兼职，这样我就可以每个星期一请假去在一位临床心理学家手下工作。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's no more exhausting in terms of me doing days of work in a week.
sentences.zh: 所以，就每周的工作天数而言，并没有更累。

sentences.en: But, of course, one of the key ways to not burn out as a human, let alone an aspiring psychologist, is to make sure that you take your annual leave.
sentences.zh: 但是，作为一个普通人，更不用说一个有抱负的心理学家，避免职业倦怠的关键方法之一就是确保休年假。

sentences.en: And, of course, that was two weeks worth of annual leave that I then wasn't able to take because I'd taken it doing honoree work.
sentences.zh: 当然，那相当于两周的年假，我因为去做了荣誉工作而无法休假。

sentences.en: Does that make more sense?
sentences.zh: 这样说更容易理解吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So you used up to two weeks of your annual leave during your internship, during your work, sorry.
sentences.zh: 所以你在实习期间用掉了最多两周的年假，抱歉，是在你的工作中。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that's what allowed me to not be at work.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这就是让我能够离开工作岗位的原因。

sentences.en: So I was on annual leave.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时在休年假。

sentences.en: I wasn't getting paid by the honoree service, but I was getting paid for my normal role.
sentences.zh: 我没有从荣誉服务那里获得薪水，但我从我的正常岗位上拿到了薪水。

sentences.en: So it didn't lead to any diminished income for me.
sentences.zh: 所以我的收入并没有减少。

sentences.en: OK, OK.
sentences.zh: 好吧，好吧。

sentences.en: I think I understand now.
sentences.zh: 我想我现在明白了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And in terms of, you know, I've just shared a little tip for reducing burnout is make sure you use your annual leave.
sentences.zh: 而且就……你知道的，我刚刚分享了一个减少职业倦怠的小建议，就是一定要确保休年假。

sentences.en: Have you got any tips to help you reduce burnout as an aspiring psychologist?
sentences.zh: 作为一名有志成为心理学家的人，你有什么减少职业倦怠的建议吗？

sentences.en: Because, you know, when you look ahead, you know, you said before we start recording, it feels like, you know, 10 years time, you know, might be like in a good place.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，当你往前看时，就像我们在录音前说的那样，感觉像是，你知道的，十年后，你知道的，可能会在一个很好的状态。

sentences.en: But at the moment, it feels like it's like, you know, on the distant horizon.
sentences.zh: 但目前，感觉它就像是，你知道的，在遥远的地平线上。

sentences.en: So how are you reducing and avoiding burnout?
sentences.zh: 所以你是如何减少和避免职业倦怠的？

sentences.en: Yeah, I feel so close yet so far.
sentences.zh: 对，我感觉既近又远。

sentences.en: I think like, I mean, I only speak from a student and a student's experience, but for me, I feel like setting up a routine, even if you don't always follow it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，我的意思是，我只能从学生和学生的经历出发，但对我来说，我觉得建立一个日常规划很有用，即使你并不总是严格遵守它。

sentences.en: Like for me personally, I feel like it's helped a lot so I don't like lose track of time and I don't, you know, waste or sit around and like not do something.
sentences.zh: 就像对我个人而言，我觉得这很有帮助，这样我就不会失去时间概念，也不会，你知道的，浪费时间、无所事事或者什么都不做。

sentences.en: I also feel like in terms to avoid burnout, like just doing something like in the middle, like some people do Pomodoro.
sentences.zh: 我还觉得，为了避免职业倦怠，比如做一些适度的事情，就像有些人用番茄工作法。

sentences.en: But personally, I've never been able to do that exactly.
sentences.zh: 但就我个人而言，我从来没有真正完全做到过那个。

sentences.en: Fix 25 and then five and 25 and five.
sentences.zh: 专注25分钟，然后休息5分钟，再25分钟和5分钟。

sentences.en: It's been hard.
sentences.zh: 这很难。

sentences.en: It's hard for me to do that.
sentences.zh: 这对我很困难。

sentences.en: But just having some other system.
sentences.zh: 但只要有其他某种系统就行。

sentences.en: Did you call it Pomodoro?
sentences.zh: 你刚才叫它番茄工作法吗？

sentences.en: Have you heard of it?
sentences.zh: 你听说过吗？

sentences.en: I always saw it on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 我总是在YouTube上看到它。

sentences.en: So it's basically this study or work technique.
sentences.zh: 所以这基本上是一种学习或工作技巧。

sentences.en: Some people, a lot of people do or some people do where you study for 25 minutes.
sentences.zh: 有些人，很多人会这样做，或者有些人会学习25分钟。

sentences.en: You have a break for five.
sentences.zh: 休息5分钟。

sentences.en: You study for 25.
sentences.zh: 学习25分钟。

sentences.en: You have a break for five.
sentences.zh: 休息5分钟。

sentences.en: Then you study for 25.
sentences.zh: 然后学习25分钟。

sentences.en: Then you have a break for five again.
sentences.zh: 然后再休息5分钟。

sentences.en: And then when you study for 25 minutes the fourth time, then you have a 30 minute break.
sentences.zh: 然后当你第四次学习25分钟后，你就可以休息30分钟。

sentences.en: So this is basically what some people do to study for like a full day or half a day or something.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是有些人用来学习一整天、半天左右的方法。

sentences.en: So they study for 25 minutes, then five minute break, like three times in a row.
sentences.zh: 所以他们学习25分钟，然后休息5分钟，连续三次。

sentences.en: Then when they study 25 minutes the fourth time, they take a 30 minute break instead of a five minute.
sentences.zh: 然后当他们第四次学习25分钟时，他们会休息30分钟，而不是5分钟。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: But I personally was never able to do that.
sentences.zh: 但我个人从来没有能够做到这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I used to do something similar with myself, but with Mars bars when I was to encourage me to study.
sentences.zh: 我以前也对自己做过类似的事情，不过是用玛氏巧克力棒来鼓励自己学习。

sentences.en: I would reward myself with Mars bars, which, yeah, probably not advisable.
sentences.zh: 我会用玛氏巧克力棒来奖励自己，这，好吧，可能不太建议这样做。

sentences.en: But in short term bursts, it worked for me.
sentences.zh: 但对于短时间的冲刺来说，这对我很有用。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: You know, it's just getting candy.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就是吃点糖果。

sentences.en: Like, well, what else could you want?
sentences.zh: 比如，你还能想要什么？

sentences.en: Like something so simple, that's so nice.
sentences.zh: 就像这么简单的事情，却这么美好。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Khalid, thank you so much for coming along to the podcast and sharing your wisdom and your thoughts and the way you see the world.
sentences.zh: 哈alid，非常感谢你来到这个播客，分享你的智慧、你的想法以及你对世界的看法。

sentences.en: It's been a real pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一次非常愉快的经历。

sentences.en: It's my pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having me here.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我来这里。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Welcome back.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening or watching, depending on which you're doing.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听或收看，取决于你正在进行哪种方式。

sentences.en: I'd love to know what you think about this episode, whether it's evoked anything for you.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道你对这一期的看法，它是否触动了你的心弦。

sentences.en: And if it has, please do come along on the aspiring psychologist community brackets free group on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 如果是的话，请加入Facebook上的“有志心理学家社区”（括号内为免费群组）。

sentences.en: And I'd love to catch up with you there.
sentences.zh: 我很期待在那里与你交流。

sentences.en: Do take a moment.
sentences.zh: 请花一点时间。

sentences.en: If you are listening as a podcast or even if you're not, if you're watching on YouTube, still to leave me a rating and a review on Apple podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你是以播客形式收听，或者即使不是，如果你在YouTube上观看，也请在Apple Podcasts上给我留个评分和评价。

sentences.en: The aspiring psychologist podcast show.
sentences.zh: 《有志心理学家播客》节目。

sentences.en: That would be really appreciated.
sentences.zh: 这将不胜感激。

sentences.en: Please do bear in mind that the books, the clinical psychologist collective and the aspiring psychologist collective can be useful for whatever stage you're at with your journey.
sentences.zh: 请记住，无论你处于旅程的哪个阶段，《临床心理学家合集》和《有志心理学家合集》这两本书都非常有用。

sentences.en: Whether it is that you've got interviews or that you're still carving out your career and gaining your experience,
sentences.zh: 无论你是面临面试，还是仍在开创你的职业生涯并积累经验，

sentences.en: ready to apply to some other area of psychology or indeed clinical psychology in future.
sentences.zh: 准备好在未来申请心理学的其他领域或临床心理学。

sentences.en: People have said that they're really useful for helping them think about reflecting and for also thinking about other opportunities and avenues for jobs.
sentences.zh: 人们表示，这些书对帮助他们思考反思以及思考其他工作机会和途径真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: So somebody contacted me recently, so they're just starting a new role and they feel so excited that it was actually reading those books that gave them the idea of that,
sentences.zh: 所以最近有人联系我，说他们刚开始一份新工作，他们感到非常兴奋，因为正是阅读了那些书，才让他们萌生了寻找那个职位的想法，

sentences.en: of even searching for that role.
sentences.zh: 甚至去搜索那个职位。

sentences.en: So, yeah, good things happen and lives are changing because of this podcast, which is wonderful.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，美好的事情正在发生，人们的生活因为这个播客而改变，这太棒了。

sentences.en: The same can be said for people within the aspiring psychologist membership that feel like they got interviews this year because of the work that we've been doing to help coach them
sentences.zh: 有志心理学家会员群的人们也是如此，他们觉得今年能获得面试机会，归功于我们为帮助他们进行教练辅导所做的工作，

sentences.en: and to help supercharge their abilities and their confidence.
sentences.zh: 以及帮助他们激发潜能和增强自信。

sentences.en: So do please consider coming on board if you think that would be useful for you.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得这会对你有所帮助，请考虑加入我们。

sentences.en: It's £30 a month, but with no minimum term.
sentences.zh: 每月30英镑，没有最低期限要求。

sentences.en: So thank you so much for listening, watching, whatever it is you're doing.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们的收听、收看，无论你们在做什么。

sentences.en: I will look forward to catching up with you for our next episode, which will be available for you from Monday at 6 a.m.
sentences.zh: 我期待在我们的下一期节目中与大家见面，该节目将于周一上午6点准时上线。

sentences.en: Thanks for being part of my world and I'll see you very soon.
sentences.zh: 感谢你成为我世界的一部分，我们很快再见。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果除了出卖时间换取金钱之外，你还能赚钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我个人的独家支持套餐，不收取任何额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组头脑风暴会、大师班、个性化指导、Fortnum & Mason礼品以及限时的一对一教练辅导福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日（星期一）晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
